summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SLA Management (SLA Profilleri, İş Saatleri, SLA Pause/Resume) and Role & Permission Management features. All 31 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all major features including SLA Settings page with tabs, SLA profile creation dialog, Business Hours tab, Role Settings page with 4 system roles, and custom role creation with permission groups.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed route ordering issue: /assets/warranty-expiring was being matched by /assets/{asset_id} - moved warranty-expiring route before the parameterized route
Fixed BusinessHours model: Dict[str, str] was causing validation errors for boolean 'enabled' field - changed to Dict[str, Any]
All SLA and Role APIs are properly implemented with authentication
System roles (admin, manager, technician, viewer) are protected from modification/deletion
SLA pause/resume correctly updates ticket deadline based on pause duration
Asset warranty/support expiry tracking correctly identifies assets expiring within specified days
seed_data_creation: Created test SLA profiles, business hours, custom roles, tickets for SLA pause/resume testing, and assets with warranty expiry dates during backend testing. Created 'Kritik SLA - P1' profile and 'Destek Uzmanı' custom role during UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All SLA Management and Role & Permission features are working correctly. Backend tests cover: SLA Profiles CRUD, Business Hours CRUD, SLA Pause/Resume, Roles CRUD, Permissions list, Asset warranty expiry, Asset history. Frontend tests verified: SLA Yönetimi sidebar link, SLA Settings page with SLA Profilleri/İş Saatleri tabs, SLA profile creation dialog with all fields, Business Hours display, Rol Yönetimi sidebar link, Role Settings page with 4 system roles, custom role creation with permission groups.
